$comment: Runtime dependencies that no source file imports by name, and the reason each one is still a dependency. Read by infra/ci/dependency-importer-ratchet.mjs: a dependency with no importer and no entry here FAILS the build; an entry here that acquires an importer, or that is no longer a dependency, ALSO fails until it is deleted. The list is a ratchet — it may shrink, never grow silently. Measured on the branch that removed ethers / casper-js-sdk / @uauth/js / @solana/spl-token / @mui/icons-material: 274 source files, 28 runtime dependencies. Next-ShopFront#288.

@emotion/react.reason: Peer of @mui/material and @mui/styled-engine (^11.5.0), and the styling engine MUI v5 actually renders through. Marked optional in MUI's peerDependenciesMeta only because @mui/styled-engine-sc is the alternative; this repo uses the emotion engine, so removing it breaks every MUI component at runtime while every static check stays green. Retired if MUI is dropped or switched to styled-components.

@emotion/styled.reason: Peer of @mui/material and @mui/styled-engine (^11.3.0), same engine as @emotion/react above and the same failure mode if removed. The two are installed and upgraded as a pair. Retired with @emotion/react.

react-dom.reason: Non-optional peer of both next (^18.2.0 || ^19) and @mui/material (^17 || ^18 || ^19). It is React's DOM renderer — Next.js imports it, application code never needs to. Removing it is an undeployable build. Retired never, while this is a React web app.

sharp.reason: Next.js image pipeline. Declared by next as an optionalDependency (^0.34.3 || ^0.35.3) and pinned at the root deliberately so the Dockerfile resolves the libvips native binaries for the runner platform rather than whatever npm picks (Dockerfile:15 and :28 record the yarn-era mismatch this prevents). next/image loads it; no source file does. Retired only if the image pipeline stops running in-process.

@mui/joy.reason: UNUSED — zero importers, no runtime requirer, kept out of the 2026-09-12 removal only to hold that PR to its measured scope. This is debt, not a justification. Retired by Next-ShopFront#289, which should delete it.
@mui/joy.requiredBy: nothing — tracked for removal in Next-ShopFront#289

@tanstack/react-query.reason: UNUSED — zero importers, no provider mounted anywhere in the tree, no runtime requirer. Data fetching here goes through src/lib/fetchInstance.ts. Debt, not a justification. Retired by Next-ShopFront#289, which should delete it.
@tanstack/react-query.requiredBy: nothing — tracked for removal in Next-ShopFront#289

axios.reason: UNUSED — zero importers. src/lib/dpp/services.ts says so in a comment: 'Next-ShopFront has no shared axios instance'. The root override axios@^1.16.0 constrains transitive copies and is unaffected by removing the direct dependency. Debt, not a justification. Retired by Next-ShopFront#289, which should delete it.
axios.requiredBy: nothing — tracked for removal in Next-ShopFront#289

buffer.reason: UNUSED — zero importers. It was the browser Buffer polyfill for the web3 stack that this branch removed, and next.config.mjs declares no resolve.fallback that would pull it in. Debt, not a justification. Retired by Next-ShopFront#289, which should delete it.
buffer.requiredBy: nothing — tracked for removal in Next-ShopFront#289
